key_insight: EPRO improves LLM reinforcement learning by predicting how learner updates change the unobserved execution policy and tempering updates when that prediction is risky.
engineering_relevance: EPRO addresses policy mismatches between rollout and training engines that share model parameters but behave differently.
method: Predict the current execution policy from observed rollout behavior and training-policy changes.
Use the predictor’s score to derive Transported Score Centering (TSC).
Use Policy Shift as a prediction-risk proxy and Shift-Aware Soft Clipping (SSC) to attenuate risky updates.
evidence_signal: Across four Qwen3 model settings, EPRO achieves the highest average held-out accuracy among compared methods on seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
watch_item: Policy Shift is a proxy for prediction risk; the abstract does not quantify how reliably it tracks execution-policy prediction error.
paper_title: EPRO: Robust Policy Optimization Through an Imperfect Execution-Policy Predictor
